items.name: India commercial SMS on DLT (TRAI TCCCPR)
items.one_line: Promotional, service, transactional and government SMS in India, which must match a DLT-registered header and content template.

limits.field: message body, one GSM-7 segment (see plat:sms_encoding_segments)
limits.quote: limited a single SMS message to 140 bytes in length. This equals 1,120 bits or 160 7-bit characters.
limits.confidence: medium (Twilio carrier-gateway docs; DLT itself sets no body length)

limits.quote: where it is not possible to put ... a variable within the limit of thirty characters, more than one contiguous variable of the same type
limits.confidence: high (TRAI TCCCPR (Second Amendment) Regulations, 12 Feb 2025, gazette text)

limits.quote: SMS Header for sending Transactional SMS, Service SMS, Promotional SMS and Government SMS from 11-character alphanumeric string, or as directed by the Authority
limits.confidence: high (TRAI TCCCPR (Second Amendment) Regulations, 12 Feb 2025, gazette text)

limits.field: variables per template (more only on justified request)
limits.quote: allow, in special circumstances and on requisition with reasons and proper justification from Principal Entity, more than three variables in the Content Templates
limits.confidence: high (TRAI TCCCPR (Second Amendment) Regulations, 12 Feb 2025, gazette text)

sources.title: TRAI Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2025
sources.supports: header suffixes, variable limits, fixed-content share, URL whitelisting, opt-out

sources.title: How to add Header or Sender ID in Jio DLT? (Fast2SMS)
sources.supports: operator-portal practice: 6-character headers (third-party)

items.note: TRAI 2025 rules: the message type is shown by a header suffix '-P', '-S', '-T', '-G' (Promotional, Service, Transactional, Government); 'minimum thirty percent characters in the Content Template shall be fixed content'; each variable must be pre-tagged for its purpose; one template may not be linked to more than one header; messages with URLs/APKs/OTT links/call-back numbers pass scrubbing only if whitelisted by the sender; a promotional message must carry an opt-out mechanism in the same message, and promotional content mixed into a service/transactional SMS makes the whole message promotional. The 'three variables' cap is implied by the clause allowing MORE than three only on justified request. CONFLICT/gap: the 6-character header length (6 letters for service/transactional, 6 digits for promotional, first digit = business category) comes from operator DLT portals and SMS vendors, not from the TRAI text, which speaks of an 11-character alphanumeric string; treat 6 as operator practice (low confidence). Encoding/segment lengths: plat:sms_encoding_segments.
